newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Dec 18.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Dec 18.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Wednesday:

* The Dow Jones industrial average ended up 39.98 points at 6,308.33 on Tuesday, propelled by the top technology and financial issues -- the same stocks that fuelled the fierce November rally, as investors returned to the market after the Federal Reserve kept interest rates unchanged.
* The United States' Federal Reserve opted on Tuesday to keep interest rates unchanged amid signs that the see-saw economy was settling down to steady growth as 1996 draws to a close.
* Association of Indonesian Automotive Association said car sales between January and November this year dropped 15 percent to 292,925 cars over the same period last year.
* The Jakarta composite index ended up 0.19 points, or 0.03 percent, at 623.81 points on Tuesday following speculative buying of some small-capitalised stocks.
* On Wednesday, the rupiah was quoted at 2,353.55/54.00 in early trading against the opening of 2,353.50/54.50.
* Pharmaceutical firm PT Tempo Scan Pacific on reports its subsidiary PT Tempo had signed a distribution agreement with consumer goods manufacturer PT Unilever Indonesia .
* Ometraco Corporation on reports the conglomerate planned to set up a joint venture insurance firm with General Accident of the United Kingdom.
* Dharmala Agrifood. on reports its 1996 net profit was expected to come mostly from asset sales from its three subsidiaries.
* Timber firm Surya Dumai on reports the Capital Market Supervisory Agency (Bapepam) was studying a proposal from the firm to use its IPO proceeds in a way different from the initial plan.
* Branta Mulia on confirmation that Du Pont of the United States had expressed interest for a possible link-up with the tyre-related goods manufacturer.
